in_sanskrit.name: Sahu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, Master, Owner
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.

in_hindi.name: Sahu
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, Master, Owner
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sahu एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.

in_tamil.name: Sahu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord, Master, Owner
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sahu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.

in_telugu.name: Sahu
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord, Master, Owner
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sahu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.

in_marathi.name: Sahu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord, Master, Owner
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.

in_bengali.name: Sahu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord, Master, Owner
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sahu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'.
